statement: WITH ranked AS (SELECT analysis_region_code, analysis_region_name, registered_bev_passenger_car_stock AS bev_stock, registered_passenger_car_stock AS passenger_car_stock, bev_penetration_percent, in_service_registered_charging_facilities AS facilities, in_service_registered_charging_points AS points, in_service_registered_fast_charging_points AS fast_points, in_service_registered_facility_nominal_power_kw AS registered_facility_nominal_power_kw, in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs AS points_per_1000_bevs, in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs AS fast_points_per_1000_bevs, in_service_registered_charging_facilities_per_1000_bevs AS facilities_per_1000_bevs, in_service_registered_facility_nominal_power_kw_per_1000_bevs AS nominal_power_kw_per_1000_bevs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY registered_bev_passenger_car_stock DESC, analysis_region_code) AS bev_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs ASC, analysis_region_code) AS low_points_ratio_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs ASC, analysis_region_code) AS low_fast_ratio_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs DESC, analysis_region_code) AS total_supply_rank_desc, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs DESC, analysis_region_code) AS fast_supply_rank_desc, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY registered_bev_passenger_car_stock DESC) AS bev_quartile, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY bev_penetration_percent DESC) AS penetration_quartile FROM __CATALOG__.gold.vw_powerbi_region_kpi_published WHERE date_set_id = '__DATE_SET_ID__'), selected AS (SELECT 'largest_bev_stock' AS screening_lens, * FROM ranked QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bev_rank) <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'high_bev_low_total_provision' AS screening_lens, * FROM ranked WHERE bev_quartile = 1 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY points_per_1000_bevs ASC, bev_rank) <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'high_bev_low_fast_provision' AS screening_lens, * FROM ranked WHERE bev_quartile = 1 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fast_points_per_1000_bevs ASC, bev_rank) <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'total_vs_fast_provision_gap' AS screening_lens, * FROM ranked QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (fast_supply_rank_desc - total_supply_rank_desc) DESC, analysis_region_code) <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT 'high_penetration_low_total_provision' AS screening_lens, * FROM ranked WHERE penetration_quartile = 1 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY points_per_1000_bevs ASC, bev_rank) <= 10) SELECT screening_lens, analysis_region_code, analysis_region_name, bev_stock, passenger_car_stock, bev_penetration_percent, facilities, points, fast_points, registered_facility_nominal_power_kw, points_per_1000_bevs, fast_points_per_1000_bevs, facilities_per_1000_bevs, nominal_power_kw_per_1000_bevs, bev_rank, low_points_ratio_rank, low_fast_ratio_rank, total_supply_rank_desc, fast_supply_rank_desc, (fast_supply_rank_desc - total_supply_rank_desc) AS total_vs_fast_rank_gap FROM selected ORDER BY screening_lens, CASE screening_lens WHEN 'largest_bev_stock' THEN bev_rank WHEN 'high_bev_low_total_provision' THEN low_points_ratio_rank WHEN 'high_bev_low_fast_provision' THEN low_fast_ratio_rank WHEN 'total_vs_fast_provision_gap' THEN -(fast_supply_rank_desc - total_supply_rank_desc) ELSE low_points_ratio_rank END, analysis_region_code
